themes.label: Trust differentiates overwhelmed users

themes.label: Recognize learning and experimentation

themes.label: Training confidence differentiates value
themes.summary: Overwhelmed high-value users more often report adequate AI training than overwhelmed low-value users.

themes.label: Make learning a practical bridge
themes.summary: Use role-specific just-in-time learning, coaching, and visible skill progression rather than adding a disconnected training burden.

No repeated participants, changing geography and composition, small subgroups, and some missing departments mean directional snapshots, not within-person growth. RIVA is mean item favorability, not a transformed mean or financial ROI.
